method.latency: Median of uninstrumented process medians after one discarded warmup per process.
method.pairing: Ratios pair the same round and workload. Allocator comparisons use the same frontend revision; frontend comparisons hold the allocator fixed.
method.ranges: Observed minimum/maximum same-round ratios, not confidence intervals or significance tests. Negative changes mean less time or lower process RSS; speedup above 1 means faster.
method.rss: Whole-process peak RSS includes verification and checked-graph JSON serialization, not frontend-only peak or retained-heap memory.
method.allocation_counts: Not collected. Custom allocator timing must not be combined with the System allocation counter study.
method.scope: Local experiment; no CI or statistical-significance claim.
